summary: Default the MCP streamable-HTTP transport to 127.0.0.1:7777 instead of the generator's wildcard :7777.
reason: The generated MCP server exposes every tool in this CLI, and those tools act with the operator's QUENTLI_SECRET_KEY, but the streamable-HTTP transport performs no inbound authentication. A wildcard default bind therefore publishes credential-backed payment, refund, and CFDI tooling to any host that can reach the port. Loopback is the safe default; --addr still allows an explicit wider bind behind an authenticating proxy. The generator emits the wildcard default for every CLI, so the durable fix belongs in the Printing Press template; this patch hardens the shipped binary in the meantime.
